question: How many vehicles will Tesla deliver in Q4 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Tesla Q4 vs Q3 deliveries; normal years +7-18%, 2025 -16% due to US tax-credit pull-forward (not repeating). Q3 2026 delivered 486,532 but produced only 464,391; the Q1 inventory excess is now cleared, so Q4 depends on production (~470-500k). Upside: European rebound (+43% YTD, 66k in Sep), Shanghai export pull-forward before China's VAT rebate cut on 1 Apr 2027, high fuel prices. Downside: weak China domestic sales (-11.9% YTD), BYD competition, lean inventory. Pre-Q3 consensus implied ~467k for Q4 and will probably be revised up after the Q3 beat. No matching human market found (Polymarket's Tesla delivery markets found were for 2025 quarters; the Manifold candidate is an unrelated Robotaxi/MKBHD bet). Median ~490k.

- Q3 consensus was 461,974; actual beat by ~25k (Tesla IR consensus / Electrek).
- Pre-Q3 analyst FY2026 consensus 1,767,255; minus H1 838,149 and the Q3 consensus implies ~467k Q4 (Seeking Alpha search snippet, ~Sep-Oct 2026). Post-Q3 revision not found.

- China domestic Jan-Sep 2026: 381,088 (-11.9% YoY); Shanghai exports 361,972 (+108%); September domestic 64,837 (-9.4%) (Electrek 2026-10-13).
- China's VAT export rebate drops 13%->9% from 2027-04-01 (announced 2026-10-13), an incentive to pull exports forward into Q4 2026/Q1 2027.
- Europe September 2026 Tesla registrations 66,035; Model Y #1 car in Europe; EU+UK+EFTA Jan-Aug +43.3% YoY, helped by easy comparisons, high fuel prices and incentives (DriveTeslaCanada / Reuters, 2026-10-01).
- US $7,500 credit expired 2025-09-30; Q4 2025 (418,227) was depressed by the pull-forward into Q3 2025. That comparison is easy for Q4 2026.
- Historical Q4 deliveries: 2022 405k, 2023 484.5k, 2024 495.6k, 2025 418.2k. Q4/Q3 ratios: 1.18, 1.11, 1.07, 0.84.
- Q3 2026 earnings and call are on 2026-10-21 after the close; any guidance is unknown as of now.
- Status quo: a Q4 similar to Q3 (~480-490k), limited by production capacity and lean inventory.
- Resolves off Tesla's Q4 2026 P&D press release total deliveries (IR site/SEC 8-K), expected ~2027-01-02.
- Event window: 2026-10-01 -> 2026-12-31 per the criteria; as of 2026-10-21 ~22% elapsed.
- Searched for but not found: a Polymarket/Kalshi Q4 2026 delivery market, a post-Q3 Q4 consensus, October 2026 China weekly registrations (search results were mostly 2025).

Q4 production usually rises and Shanghai exports are being pulled forward before the April 2027 rebate cut. Europe is strong and China domestic weak. calls.reconciliation: No factual disputes: all runs share the same Q3 data, the same pre-Q3 implied Q4 consensus (~467k) and the same finding of no matching market. The spread (476k vs 488-490k) is judgment about how production-bound Q4 is. Run 3 leans on the 464k Q3 production; runs 1-2 lean on seasonality and export pull-forward. I side partly with runs 1-2 because Q4 production typically rises and Q4 2024 deliveries far exceeded production, but I temper that for analyst over-optimism on Tesla and weak US/China domestic demand. Q3 earnings-call guidance (Oct 21, after close) was unavailable. No web access this run.
